notes.title: Minor Update 2025/5/3
notes.content:
Adjusted cloth physics

Modified the hitbox range of the burrowing poison-spitting enemy

Fixed a display issue with the scythe when launching the game for the second time

notes.title: Minor Update 2025/5/2
notes.content:
Added a cooldown time for the dodge ability, which is now reflected in the game UI. Corresponding functionality has also been added to the character upgrade page.

Added a feature to unlock all event animations directly after clearing a level.

notes.title: Minor Update 2025/4/30
notes.content:
Removed action point cost for dodging

Fixed UI bugs

Adjusted the sprint speed of the Fat Zombie
